policy: Tasks may unlock a KPI only after non-empty evidence, DQC, denominator coverage and authority review all pass.

tasks.next_gate: 建立脱敏 Payment CDC 并完成按租户、checkpoint 的非空行数对账。
tasks.action: Add pay_order and pay_refund to a dedicated, masked Payment CDC route; build payment attempt/refund DWD and a current+history DWS. Do not treat Order's payment reference as Payment authority.
acceptance: ODS count reconciles to source by tenant and checkpoint
Payment attempt status and channel are preserved without credentials or payer PII
success-rate denominator includes initiated attempts, not only captured payments

tasks.next_gate: LOCAL_TEST Session→Order/Payment 归因已关闭；下一门禁是生产 Payment Intent/Attempt 分母与持续流量。
tasks.action: Append-only session/search/PDP/cart/checkout plus strict Session→Order/Payment attribution are live through API→Outbox→CDC→DWD/DIM/DWS/ADS in LOCAL_TEST. Continue with production Payment Intent/Attempt denominator coverage.
acceptance: Events are append-only and idempotent
Anonymous-to-principal stitching is versioned and privacy reviewed
Search request, exposure, click and order lineage can be joined without raw query text leakage
Current trade_cart and product_browse_history are never used as historical event denominators

tasks.next_gate: 闭合剩余买家、历史 SKU、Order/OrderItem 与 Shop/Merchant 的显式映射。
tasks.action: Backfill buyer-to-principal, order-to-shop/merchant and legacy-SKU-to-canonical-SKU mappings with validity intervals and explicit unresolved rows.
acceptance: Every denominator reports resolved, unresolved and conflicted counts
Historical mappings are time-valid and never inferred from the current catalog alone
Legacy history remains LEGACY_SOURCE_ONLY until money and identity DQC both pass

tasks.next_gate: 三类版本化 Promise/SLA 已完成 LOCAL_TEST 运行闭环；下一门禁是扩大生产样本与持续对账窗口。
tasks.action: Fulfillment promise, Procurement OTIF and Customer Service SLA are live through authoritative facts→Outbox→CDC→ADS in LOCAL_TEST. Keep the same contracts while expanding production cohorts.
acceptance: Promise/SLA version is frozen on each business case
Actual milestones cannot overwrite promised timestamps
Timezone, grace period and pause semantics are explicit

tasks.next_gate: 订单盈利、平台收入与 FIFO 成本已完成 LOCAL_TEST 对账；下一门禁是总账控制数与生产结算批次。
tasks.action: Append-only platform revenue, order-time profitability and FIFO Inventory cost evidence now feed governed ADS metrics in LOCAL_TEST. Expand to production settlement and GL control totals without changing metric formulas.
acceptance: Every amount has currency, minor-unit scale, accounting date and immutable business reference
Order cost is frozen at fulfillment/settlement time
Ledger totals reconcile to settlement and general-ledger control totals

tasks.next_gate: 首响、一次解决和 SLA 已出现本地非空值；下一步扩展更多队列、优先级和重开场景。
tasks.action: Keep the governed first-response, first-contact-resolution and SLA marts in place; expand representative ticket/message/reopen flows and harden repeated Outbox-to-ADS evidence.
acceptance: Ticket, first human outbound message and resolution timestamps are non-empty
Message content and attachments remain outside aggregate dashboard outputs
Internal quality review is not published as buyer CSAT

tasks.next_gate: 买家反馈、风险审查、拒付与损失账本已完成 LOCAL_TEST；下一门禁是生产支付机构争议回执和财务总账对账。
tasks.action: Buyer-authored feedback, payment dispute/chargeback and order-linked risk loss lifecycles now feed governed metrics in LOCAL_TEST; preserve explicit outcomes and signed amount ledgers for production expansion.
acceptance: Survey response is buyer-authored and sample size is exposed
Risk facts carry governed order/payment references
Chargeback and loss amounts reconcile to Payment and Finance authorities
